# Dove Medical Press

> Dove Medical Press is a leading open-access publisher of peer-reviewed medical journals spanning clinical research, healthcare innovation, and emerging medical topics.

Dove Medical Press operates a portfolio of high-impact open-access medical journals with rigorous peer-review processes following COPE ethical standards. The platform serves researchers, clinicians, and healthcare professionals by providing freely accessible, high-quality medical research across diverse specialties including oncology, dermatology, pain management, and metabolic health.

## Core Publishing Platform

- [Dove Medical Press Homepage](https://www.dovepress.com): Main portal for open access peer-reviewed medical journals
- [Journal Directory](https://www.dovepress.com/journals): Complete directory of Dove Press medical journals with citation metrics and rankings
- [Article Collections & Archives](https://www.dovepress.com/articles/collections): Collections and archive of peer-reviewed medical journal articles organized by topic
- [Browse Hot Topics](https://www.dovepress.com/browse_hot_topics.php): Trending topics and emerging research areas across medical journals
- [Author Testimonials](https://www.dovepress.com/why-publish-with-dove-press/testimonials): Author feedback and testimonials about publishing experiences with Dove Press

## Manuscript Submission & Guidelines

- [Submit a Manuscript](https://www.dovepress.com/submit_step_1.php): Manuscript submission workflow and author registration process
- [Author Guidelines](https://www.dovepress.com/author-guidelines): Comprehensive guidelines for manuscript preparation, formatting, and submission requirements
- [Editorial Policies](https://www.dovepress.com/editorial-policies): Editorial policies and publication ethics guidelines aligned with COPE standards
- [Presubmission Checklist](https://www.dovepress.com/presubmission_check.php): Pre-submission checklist and manuscript evaluation guidelines before formal submission
- [Peer Review Guidelines](https://www.dovepress.com/peer-review-guidelines): Standards and expectations for peer reviewers following COPE ethical guidelines

## Publishing & Licensing Information

- [Permissions & Copyright](https://www.dovepress.com/permissions.php): Instructions for obtaining permissions and copyright licensing for published articles
- [About Dove Medical Press](https://www.dovepress.com/about-us): Company information, mission, and publishing practices of Dove Medical Press
- [Bulk Reprints Service](https://www.dovepress.com/bulk_reprints.php): Bulk reprint and printing solutions for pharmaceutical and healthcare industry partners

## Content & Engagement

- [Call for Papers Collections](https://www.dovepress.com/call-for-papers-collections): Call for papers for special article collections on emerging research topics and themes
- [Expert Podcasts](https://www.dovepress.com/podcasts): Podcast series featuring expert interviews on clinical and medical research topics
- [Press Releases](https://www.dovepress.com/press-releases): Press releases and announcements about notable journal publications and research findings

## Support & Contact

- [Contact Us](https://www.dovepress.com/contact): Contact information and support resources for authors and manuscript inquiries
